description: This Java source file is a Spring MVC controller named 'OptionsValueController' that manages product option values, including listing, creating, editing, deleting, and image handling functionalities within an admin interface of an e-commerce application.

classes.name: OptionsValueController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for managing product option values in the admin panel.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Displays the list view for product option values.

methods.name: displayOptionEdit
methods.description: Displays the edit form for a specific product option value identified by id.

methods.name: displayOption
methods.description: Prepares and displays the form for creating or editing a product option value, including descriptions per language.

methods.name: saveOption
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update a product option value, including validation, image upload, and persistence.

methods.name: pageOptions
methods.description: Provides paginated data for product option values in JSON format for AJAX calls.

methods.name: deleteOptionValue
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to delete a product option value.

methods.name: removeImage
methods.description: AJAX handler to remove an image associated with a product option value.
